latest_release.name: v1.7.9
latest_release.body:
Sliver v1.7.9 focuses on smaller implants, generated release implants take up less space, the bundled Go and Garble build tools have been updated, and implant generation now catches more errors in generated code. You can select an implant by name when staging from scripts, and the MCP bridge stays available after periods of inactivity. This release also improves built-in documentation search, fixes update reminders disrupting the initial console prompt, and addresses bugs in updates, configuration handling, website management, and operator administration.

## What's Changed
* build(deps): bump brace-expansion in /docs/sliver-docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2389
* build(deps): bump dompurify from 3.4.13 to 3.4.16 in /docs/sliver-docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2388
* build(deps): bump next from 16.3.3 to 16.3.6 in /docs/sliver-docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2390
* build(docs): update npm dependencies by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2391
* Improve embedded docs search relevance by @zwanski2019 in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2396
* Random Bug Fixes by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2395
* build(deps): bump actions/deploy-pages from 4 to 5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2401
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2400
* build(deps): bump actions/cache from 5 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2399
* build(deps): bump actions/upload-pages-artifact from 4 to 5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2398
* build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2397
* Update embedded Go and Garble to 1.27.2 by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2406
* build(deps): bump actions/configure-pages from 5 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2409
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-go from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2410
* Add non-interactive support for 'implants stage' by @rob-cshub in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2405
* client/cli: keep the MCP bridge alive across idle gRPC channels by @skinnypuppy in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2408
* Fix update reminder corrupting the initial console prompt by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2412
* Update embedded Go and Garble to 1.27.3 by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2414
* Reduce implant sizes across obfuscated and release builds by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2422
* Harden protobuf obfuscation generation by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2423
* build(deps): consolidate eight compatible Dependabot updates by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2424
* Revert docs dependency updates that break documentation loading by @moloch-- in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2425

## New Contributors
* @zwanski2019 made their first contribution in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2396
* @rob-cshub made their first contribution in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2405
* @skinnypuppy made their first contribution in https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/pull/2408

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver/compare/v1.7.8...v1.7.9
